about: PM-1a scenario set v2, PROPOSED (not active): PM-1's replayable scenario set (docs/manager-agent.md, section 8; S-223). Made-up but faithful paraphrases of the kinds of request the owner sent across MetaSoar, Morphogen, Substrate and the kernel in the sessions of 2026-11-25 to 2026-11-27; no names, paths outside the projects, accounts or personal details. Labels were written before any arm ran. Each scenario is replayed against the fixture portfolio below plus its own 'given'; 'event' scenarios are injected as channel signals, not as the person's words. expected.action: start (a pm_worker_start), answer (from pm_portfolio or the kernel's read tools, no worker), ask (desktop_ask: the request is ambiguous), message (pm_worker_message to a running worker), decision (pm_decision_open for the person), stop (pm_worker_stop), ack (nothing for the person). expected.also lists other actions scored as correct. expected.escalate: whether the person must be asked or notified. brief_must_carry: the facts a start's brief must hold for the worker to finish without coming back to ask. Added in v2: source (v1 | session-paraphrase | incident | variation-of:<id>), label_confidence (high | medium | low), label_reason. Every v2 label is the model's proposal until the owner confirms it (scenarios-v2-review.md); then split_v2.py makes the split. Variations never go to a different split than their parent family.
